content.overview: BNS s. 349 — Selling goods marked with a counterfeit property mark.
content.study:
Introduction and meaning
Selling goods marked with a counterfeit property mark. BNS restatement of IPC 486. Elements are substantially the same; cite the BNS number for offences on or after 1 July 2024. BNS restatement of IPC 486. Cite the BNS number for facts on or after 1 July 2024.
In student language: BNS s. 349 is the rule on “Selling goods marked with a counterfeit property mark”. The section provides that . Whoever sells, or exposes, or has in possession for sale, any goods or things with a counterfeit property mark affixed to or impressed upon the same or to or upon any case, package or other receptacle in which such goods are contained, shall, unless he proves—. Do not stop at the heading. An examiner awards marks for the ingredients, the explanations and the illustrations, not for writing the title alone.

Why this is asked
Criminal law arguments turn on statutory ingredients. BNS s. 349 exists so that “Selling goods marked with a counterfeit property mark” has a closed legal test in Chapter XVIII — Of Offences Relating to Documents and to Property Marks. An authoritative analysis defines the concept, lists every ingredient, walks the statutory illustrations, states exceptions, and applies the test methodically to facts.
Chapter setting: False documents, forgery, using a forged electronic record, property marks.

The provision in detail
349.. Whoever sells, or exposes, or has in possession for sale, any goods or things with a counterfeit property mark affixed to or impressed upon the same or to or upon any case, package or other receptacle in which such goods are contained, shall, unless he proves—

(a) that, having taken all reasonable precautions against committing an offence against this section, he had at the time of the commission of the alleged offence no reason to suspect the genuineness of the mark; and

(b) that, on demand made by or on behalf of the prosecutor, he gave all the information in his power with respect to the persons from whom he obtained such goods or things; or

(c) that otherwise he had acted innocently,

be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to one year, or with fine, or with both

Essential ingredients

hypotheticals.question: Whether BNS s. 349 (Selling goods marked with a counterfeit property mark) applies, and how structured written arguments should be framed.
hypotheticals.analysis:
Step 1 — Identify the provision. The correct current-law cite is BNS s. 349 (Selling goods marked with a counterfeit property mark), Chapter XVIII — Of Offences Relating to Documents and to Property Marks.
Step 2 — State the legal test in your own words, then list the ingredients:
   (1) . Whoever sells, or exposes, or has in possession for sale, any goods or things with a counterfeit property mark affixed to or impressed upon the same or to or upon any case, package or other receptacle in which such goods are contained, shall, unless he proves—
   (2) (a) that, having taken all reasonable precautions against committing an offence against this section, he had at the time of the commission of the alleged offence no reason to suspect the genuineness of the mark; and
   (3) (b) that, on demand made by or on behalf of the prosecutor, he gave all the information in his power with respect to the persons from whom he obtained such goods or things; or
   (4) (c) that otherwise he had acted innocently,
   (5) be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to one year, or with fine, or with both
Step 3 — Check limitations, provisos and the rest of the Chapter so you do not apply s. 349 in a vacuum.
Step 4 — Map each fact to an ingredient. Write “this fact proves ingredient (a)” or “this fact is missing, so the section is not made out”.
Step 5 — Conclude. If every essential ingredient is proved and no exception covers the case, BNS s. 349 applies. If any essential ingredient fails, say so and stop. Do not invent a different section to save the answer.
